headline: Graduate Software Engineer
heroTagline: I build software end to end, from React and mobile front ends to the Express APIs, networks and self-hosted infrastructure that run them.
availability: Open to graduate software engineering roles

education.note: I also wrote the technical design specifications for my final-year projects, turning open-ended requirements into plans I could actually build from.

about: I'm a software engineer based in London. I graduated from {{university}} in July 2026 with a First in Computer Science, and I'm now looking for my first full-time engineering role.

What I enjoy most is owning a problem from the first sketch to the thing actually running somewhere. For my final-year project that was MASS, a React Native app that pulls photos and video from a phone, Google Photos and a home NAS into one timeline, along with the Express API and CI/CD pipeline behind it. I've also built a GPS treasure hunt game, a native Android habit tracker in Kotlin and a 240 GHz Doppler radar on an ESP32.

Infrastructure is the other half of it. Since 2020 I've spent my summers volunteering as a network engineer at a large multi-site event, helping keep 2,000+ people online at 99.9% uptime. At home that turned into a Proxmox homelab running around 15 self-hosted services. If something can be self-hosted, I've probably tried it.
